newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News says Q1 profit growth not 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News says Q1 profit growth not 20 pct.

text.p: News Corp Ltd chairman Rupert Murdoch said on Tuesday that profit growth in the first quarter of the 1996/97 year would not be the 20 percent previously forecast for the full year.
"I don't think we'll get the full 20 percent," Murdoch told reporters after the annual meeting, when asked about his comments in the meeting about the first quarter being below expectations.

Earlier at the annual meeting, Murdoch told shareholders the global media group's first quarter performance had been below target, but that News Corp remained on track for a 20 percent profit rise in the year to June 30, 1997.
News Corp reported a net profit of A$1.02 billion, down from A$1.365 billion in 1994/95.
